title: Apps
description: Installed apps, app counts and clearing app caches

actions.label: App counts
actions.command:
printf 'Installed  %s
System     %s
Disabled   %s
' "$(pm list packages -3 --user 0 | wc -l)" "$(pm list packages -s --user 0 | wc -l)" "$(pm list packages -d --user 0 | wc -l)"

actions.label: Clear app caches
actions.command: before=$(df -k /data | awk 'NR==2{print $4}'); pm trim-caches 999G && after=$(df -k /data | awk 'NR==2{print $4}') && awk -v a="$before" -v b="$after" 'BEGIN{printf "Caches cleared, %.0f MB freed\n", (b-a)/1024}'
